result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but one clear defect is visible: the 'Popular' section heading shows a raw localization key instead of translated text. A few smaller polish issues are also present.

issues.description: The section heading reads 'home_feed.popular_title', which is an untranslated i18n key. The translation is missing or failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and set a fallback locale so raw keys are never shown to users.

issues.description: The '15–25 min' time badge on the Green Bowl Poké card overlaps the edge of the illustrated plate. Its position is also inconsistent with the other cards, where the badge sits over a dark background. The white pill on the light card has weak separation.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle shadow or border to the badge, and make sure the image composition leaves room for the badge.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (e.g. '€0.90 delivery' and the meta line under the restaurant names) and the search placeholder are light gray on white and have low contrast. The heart icon on the pizza card sits on a semi-transparent dark circle that blends into the wooden background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text to meet WCAG 4.5:1 contrast, and give the favorite button a more opaque or lighter background.
